title: clearfelt qualitative-signals manifest
description: Documents tests/fixtures/qualitative/manifest.json's shape, read by scripts/qualitative-eval.mjs. Same documentation-only role as schemas/eval-manifest.schema.json (not a validation engine this repo runs, see CLAUDE.md's dependency-free rule). Covers the five 'Qualitative signals' in reference/audit.md, which are a reasoning step performed by whoever runs /clearfelt audit or /clearfelt rewrite, not something scripts/detect.mjs can check with a regex.

expected.description: All five booleans use the same polarity: true means the fixture exhibits the human-like quality (noSynonymCycling being true means it does NOT cycle synonyms).
